name: Manoj Vaibhav Gems 'N' Jewellers Limited
summary: Manoj Vaibhav Gems 'N' Jewellers Limited is a jewelry retailer operating mainly in India. It sells gold and diamond ornaments in traditional styles, such as bangles, harams and mangalsutras, and modern ones like earrings, chains, rings and necklaces. It also trades gold and silver coins and offers silver articles for gifts, pooja and household use.
